purpose: Licensed real food photography candidates for a local German Doener restaurant website

license.name: Unsplash License
license.summary: The official Unsplash License permits free commercial use, downloading and modification. It excludes selling unmodified images and building a competing image service.
license.selection_evidence: These photographs appear as ordinary Download entries, without the Unsplash+ label, on the official Unsplash search pages listed below. Nearby premium entries are explicitly labeled For Unsplash+. The download links resolved to the original images.unsplash.com assets. No Unsplash+ asset was selected.
license.verification_limit: The official search results, contributor profiles where available, download targets, and license were retrieved. Individual short-form photo-detail pages did not render through the web tool; photo_page URLs below are the Unsplash photo-ID routes corresponding to the observed official download links.

selected.composition: Close, angled view of a generous meat-and-salad kebab in a paper sleeve, with fries, on warm white hexagonal tiles. Appetizing texture, no visible people or brands. Strongest selected hero photo.
selected.crop_guidance: Square or 4:5 center crop works. Keep the open end of the wrap around 55% x / 56% y; the paper sleeve may run out of frame at the upper left. The warm pale tile background relates to the paper palette.
selected.subject_note: Real kebab in rolled flatbread with fries; use as illustrative food photography, not as an exact product-specification image for a German Doener pocket.
selected.suggested_alt_de: Kebab im Fladenbrot mit Fleisch, Salat und Pommes auf hellen Fliesen

selected.recommended_placement: Secondary editorial image or Falafel menu card
selected.composition: Bowl of golden falafel with one split to reveal green herbs, neutral gray background, lemon, herbs and hummus. The upper third supplies quiet background; the bowl is in the lower-right half.
selected.crop_guidance: Portrait shows the full editorial setting. For a square menu card, crop toward the lower half, with the falafel bowl centered near 67% x / 65% y.
selected.suggested_alt_de: Goldbraune Falafel mit frischen Kraeutern, Zitrone und Hummus
selected.decode_verification: Pillow Image.verify() and full Image.load() succeeded with ImageFile.LOAD_TRUNCATED_IMAGES=False.
selected.replacement_note: Replaces the incomplete original-resolution download falafel-ludovic-avice.jpg. Use this 1600 px file.

selected.recommended_placement: Optional third image: wrap menu card or wide food detail
selected.composition: A cut toasted wrap in extreme close-up, with colorful vegetables and sauce. Dark blurred background. The photograph is tagged vegan on the Unsplash search result, so do not label it as a specific meat filling.
selected.crop_guidance: Best in a landscape crop. A square crop should preserve the cross-section of the wrap in the center-right area. Do not use this as a full-height portrait hero because its appeal depends on the full horizontal wrap.
selected.suggested_alt_de: Angeschnittener geroesteter Wrap mit Gemuese und cremiger Sauce

attribution_suggestion: Fotos: Anima Visual, Ludovic Avice und Eugene Kucheruk / Unsplash. Attribution is optional under the license; retain source links in the project record.
